export const meta = {
  name: 'blind-answer-judging-round3',
  description: 'Two independent blind judges decide answer equivalence for the larger-model replies (two chunks)',
  phases: [{ title: 'Judge' }],
}
const dir = '<repo>/article/evidence/comparison'
const instructions = (judge, chunk, reverse) => `You are an answer-equivalence judge for a scientific evaluation. Read ONLY the file ${dir}/judge-pairs-${chunk}.jsonl (one JSON object per line: pid, statement, reference, candidate). Do not read any other file, do not use git, and do not try to find out which model produced an answer.

For every pair decide whether the CANDIDATE states the same final result as the REFERENCE answer to the problem in STATEMENT:
- "same": the candidate's final answer has the same values as the reference (numbers equal, allowing rounding to the reference's precision), the same verdict (e.g. feasible / not feasible, yes / no, can wait / must order), and the same selection (e.g. the same set of coalitions, the same option or hypothesis). Wording, units words, order of listed items, punctuation, and extra explanation that does not contradict the result do not matter.
- "different": any final value, verdict, or selection differs, is missing, or the candidate states two conflicting final answers, or it answers a different question.
- "unclear": you cannot tell from the text.
Judge equivalence to the reference only; do not re-solve the problem and do not second-guess the reference.

Work through the pairs ${reverse ? 'from the LAST line to the first' : 'from the first line to the last'}. Write one JSON line per pair to ${dir}/judge-${judge}-${chunk}.jsonl: {"pid": "...", "verdict": "same" | "different" | "unclear", "reason": "one short sentence"}. Append as you go, in batches. Every pid in the input must appear exactly once. Do not write scripts that decide verdicts; judge each pair yourself. When finished, reply with the counts of each verdict.`
const jobs = []
for (const chunk of [5, 6]) { jobs.push({ judge: 'A', chunk, reverse: false }); jobs.push({ judge: 'B', chunk, reverse: true }) }
const results = await parallel(jobs.map(j => () => agent(instructions(j.judge, j.chunk, j.reverse), { label: `judge-${j.judge}-${j.chunk}`, phase: 'Judge' })))
return results.map((r, i) => ({ job: `${jobs[i].judge}-${jobs[i].chunk}`, reply: String(r).slice(0, 200) }))
